en: An antique, sepia-toned postcard depicting a panoramic view of a European city surrounded by hills. In the background, a wooded hill rises above the town with a visible clock tower and scattered buildings. The image is annotated in an ornate script, with a printed caption in German: 'Graz, v. d. Hilmwarte'. There is handwritten correspondence and a date '24.12.1898' on the lower right.
